atoms.exact_source_text: MEDIAN explicitly permits the **Bare Core-Species Singular**: the Initial-capped singular name of a Core Species may appear without an article when one representative body expresses the characteristic perception, action, spatial logic, or civilizational grammar of the species.
atoms.normalized_claim: MEDIAN permits an article-free, Initial-capped singular Core-Species name (Bare Core-Species Singular) when a representative body expresses the species' characteristic perception, action, spatial logic, or civilizational grammar.
The Bare Core-Species Singular takes singular agreement.

atoms.exact_source_text: This is a marked house construction, related to the linguistic idea of a **bare generic singular**.
atoms.normalized_claim: The construction is a marked usage related to the linguistic concept of a bare generic singular.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is intentionally available as poetic, naturalist, and doctrinal prose.
atoms.normalized_claim: The construction is intentionally available for use in poetic, naturalist, and doctrinal prose.

atoms.exact_source_text: The sentence does not describe one particular runtime Citizen unless context identifies one.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Bare Core-Species Singular sentence does not refer to a specific runtime Citizen unless context identifies one.

atoms.exact_source_text: Both are grammatical in MEDIAN authorial prose, but the framing differs:
atoms.normalized_claim: Both the bare singular and plural generic forms are grammatical in MEDIAN authorial prose, though their framing differs.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Squirrel connects…** | Archetypal and doctrinal: one representative body expresses the species logic. |
atoms.normalized_claim: The bare singular form 'Squirrel connects…' is archetypal and doctrinal, with one representative body expressing the species logic.

atoms.exact_source_text: | **Squirrels connect…** | Ordinary plural generalization about members of the species. |
atoms.normalized_claim: The plural generic form 'Squirrels connect…' is an ordinary plural generalization about members of the species.

atoms.exact_source_text: Use the bare singular when bodily perception or species doctrine is foregrounded.
atoms.normalized_claim: Authors should use the bare singular when bodily perception or species doctrine is foregrounded.

atoms.exact_source_text: Use the plural generic when describing populations, repeated behavior, or ordinary members of the species.
atoms.normalized_claim: Authors should use the plural generic when describing populations, repeated behavior, or ordinary members of the species.
